summary: Motion 2.0 final source batch: instant Clipboard switching and rendering safeguards

changes.title: Instant Clipboard switching
changes.detail: Remove the Clipboard panel morph in both directions and cancel previous shared-key overlays before switching. ABC to Emoji Browse keeps its existing animation.

changes.title: Hidden-panel glass cleanup
changes.detail: Release hidden panel display lists, observers and frame callbacks; rebuild glass when visible without changing its appearance.

changes.title: Constrained-device rendering
changes.detail: Skip speculative layout warmup in power saver or on low-RAM devices; cancel panel overlays during memory cleanup.

changes.title: Accessibility and frame safeguards
changes.detail: Use native presentation for optional motion when touch exploration or system motion settings require it. Add Emoji Search callback-gap fallback and preserve ordinary Scale timing.
